newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Calumet Memorial Park Dist, Ill..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Calumet Memorial Park Dist, Ill..

text.p: General Obligation Limited Tax Park Bonds, Series 1996 Sealed bids will be received until 7:00 o'clock P.M., Central Daylight Time, on at the Park District Business Office, 620 Wentworth Avenue Calumet City, Illinois 60409, for the above-described Bonds, dated October 1, 1996 and maturing on January 1 of the years and in the amounts as follows:
The Bonds will be issued in fully registered form, in denominations of $5,000 and any integral multiple thereof.

The Park District will furnish the Bonds and approving opinion of Chapman and Cutler, Chicago, Illinois. Bids must be for all or none, for not less than par and accrued interest on the Official Bid Form which, together with the Official Notice of Sale and financial information may be obtained from the undersigned.
